name: Pagination
summary: A page selector for a paged list or table — prev / numbered pages with ellipsis / next; two sizes, a simple mode, and a whole-control disabled state.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-pagination> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; give it `total`+`page-size` (or a direct `pages` count) and `current` and it computes a page WINDOW with ellipses for long ranges — prev / numbered pages / next. It ships two `size`s (default 32px, `small` 24px), a `simple` mode that collapses the numbers to prev · n / total · next, and a whole-control `disabled` state. The current page is brand-filled; prev/next disable at the ends; hover animates via the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes; arrows use the DS caret glyph via <aha-icon>. Emits a composed `change` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `change`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: total
props.desc: Total item count across all pages (used with page-size)

props.name: page-size
props.desc: Items per page; total ÷ page-size decides the page count

props.name: pages
props.desc: Direct page count; wins over total+page-size when set

props.name: current
props.desc: The active page (1-based); reflected as it changes

props.name: simple
props.desc: Collapse the numbers to prev · n / total · next

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the whole control (every cell not-allowed)

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on page change, detail { page }

whenToUse.when: a long list or table is split into pages the user steps through
a feed the user grazes — not a set they navigate by position
occasional appends where exact page position doesn't matter

opinion.note: Show pagination only when there is more than one page. Keep page cells on the 32px square + radius-8 scale (or the 24px small scale for dense tables), and reserve the brand fill for the current page. The first/last ellipsis keeps long ranges compact; reach for simple mode when width is tight.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Pagination component-set taxonomy: Pagination (the control) + Pagination / Page (the cell, carrying size + state variants) + a prev/next arrow. The family is size (default · small), the page window with ellipses for elided ranges, a current (brand-filled) page, a simple mode (prev · n / total · next), and a whole-control disabled. No measured Pagination cell ships in the reference set, so px/rgb are derived from the token layer (white rest, border #E3E3E3, border-hover #D3B4FF, color-primary #6A1EBB current fill, text-inverse label, radius-default 8 / radius-sm 6 small, text-tertiary ellipsis) + AntD Pagination conventions. Motion + arrow glyphs bound to the shared motion tokens and the DS icon library.
